title: rosa glutinosa var. dalmatica
intro: Rosa glutinosa var. dalmatica, commonly known as Dalmatian rose, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) and is native to the Balkan Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Dalmatian rose include its ability to stimulate wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Rosa glutinosa var. dalmatica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
